scope: Specialized native integer-dictionary loops and checked named assignments

implementation: Use an explicit repr(C) data/length view rather than interpreting Rust Vec memory layout.
Inline only unique dense integer vectors with integer keys, in-bounds accesses, integer write values and mutable bindings.
Route representation changes, sparse/owned keys, bounds failures and readonly writes through tagged VM contracts; refresh cached views after helper writes.
Reject slot redefinition/release in specialization eligibility; avoid creating redundant SSA aliases for physical dictionary slots.
Resolve loop global writes through the existing locked Environment and assign_checked without reacquiring its mutex.
